name: echolog
description: Record and review local EchoLog activity from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Record and review local work with EchoLog.
interface.longDescription: Use the local EchoLog CLI from Codex to explicitly track work and review activity without sending records to a remote service.
defaultPrompt: Use $track-work to start recording my current task in EchoLog.
Use $track-work to add a blocker to my active EchoLog record.
Use $review-work to summarize today's EchoLog activity.
